subject: general
question: Pushkar Mela is held in Pushkar. Which district does it come under?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Ajmer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Pushkar fair** is the **largest camel, horse and cattle fair** in Ajmer.
 
• Aside from the trading of livestock, **it is an important pilgrimage season for Hindus to the Pushkar lake**.
 
• In 2022, Pushkar Fair will be celebrated from **11th November 2022 to 19th November 2022**.
 
• The Pushkar Camel Fair in Pushkar is **celebrated at the beginning of the Hindu month of Kartik.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90d5fce2b3092e254a31923e0a8c1a0e10eaef934cc19b1ba1bd5cda8b4ef832.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Amer is now **part of the Jaipur urban agglomeration**. 
 
• **The Adventure festival** is one of the most fascinating festivals of **Rajasthan in Kota.****​ **
 
• **Kolayat fair** is held in **Bikaner, Rajasthan.**
